caption: The drawing depicts a single brown horse standing in profile facing right. The horse's body is rendered in shades of reddish-brown, with darker tones accentuating areas such as the legs, muzzle, and lower parts of the body, while lighter areas highlight the shoulder, hip, and barrel. The mane and tail are illustrated with darker brown streaks, and the mane is combed in one broad section along the neck, with the tail hanging straight down. The horse stands on a horizontal, dark-colored bar or platform, which extends the length of the image beneath its hooves. The background is a plain, light beige color without any additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature, "CHRIST. MARCKEN," is visible near the lower right side, close to the horse's front legs.
title: Horse Weather Vane
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
